serverInfo.title: Advocate
serverInfo.description: Find participating local businesses, read their published services and policies, and request a quote or callback. Eligible businesses offer a quote-request form. Other tools support configured availability, reservation requests, pending subscriptions and human handoffs. Price estimates and business-agent answers may use AI; a quote request does not confirm a price or booking.
